arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Verify immutability - original should not be modified
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'alpha.1', 'build.1')
original_id = id(v)
print('Original:', v, 'id:', original_id)

result = v.bump_major()
print('After bump_major:', result, 'id:', id(result))
print('Original after bump:', v, 'id:', id(v))
assert id(v) == original_id, 'Original object changed!'
assert v.major == 3, 'Original major changed!'
print('Immutability verified!')

# Verify different types of tokens work
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_prerelease(token='dev')
print('bump_prerelease with dev token:', result)
assert result.prerelease == 'dev.1'

result2 = v.bump_build(token='git')
print('bump_build with git token:', result2)
assert result2.build == 'git.1'
print('Custom tokens work!')
"
